intro: A fresh fortnight of experimental performance, participatory art, AI and unusual cultural experiences in Stockholm.

top3.title: VERKLIGHETEN — live film and AI theatre
top3.description: A real film studio is assembled live, with audience members potentially becoming extras as AI-assisted environments transform the scene. Swedish-language; especially compelling for participatory theatre and AI.
top3.price: Price unverified; subscriber booking conditions apply
top3.booking: Tickets listed 13–14 Nov; few left 16 Nov

top3.description: An anniversary program revisiting experimental art and technology, with sessions at Fylkingen and Tekniska museet. Particularly worth checking for its crossovers between art, electronics and future-facing ideas.
top3.price: Some sessions free; other prices unverified

new_discoveries.title: Klang Systematiek: Christian Marclay & Giuseppe Chiari
new_discoveries.description: An experimental sound/art encounter built around two influential artists whose practices blur performance, musical scores and visual art. Good for a curious evening outside conventional concerts.

new_discoveries.title: Musiken och maskinen: AI i konstnärligt skapande
new_discoveries.description: An unusually direct match for your work: a public exploration of how AI and machines enter artistic practice, rather than another generic technology lecture.

new_discoveries.title: Visioner av Nuet 1966–2026
new_discoveries.description: An anniversary program revisiting experimental art and technology, with sessions at Fylkingen and Tekniska museet. Particularly worth checking for its crossovers between art, electronics and future-facing ideas.
new_discoveries.price: Some sessions free; other prices unverified

new_discoveries.title: Art of: Drag x Admira — November Night
new_discoveries.description: A hybrid of exhibition, costume design, live singing and performance, with the artist's transformation itself becoming part of the artwork. Swedish-language show.

new_discoveries.title: Nysnö Breathwork & Drum Journey XL
new_discoveries.description: Guided breathwork with live ceremonial drums and a closing sound bath in the acoustically striking Eric Ericsonhallen. A participatory alternative to passive cultural viewing.
new_discoveries.booking: Tickets listed via Nortic; seats unverified

new_discoveries.title: Breathwork med Hale — Yin / Yang
new_discoveries.description: An immersive 90-minute guided sequence from gentle restorative breathing to a more energetic second half, including museum entry.

new_discoveries.title: INCANT
new_discoveries.description: A contemporary experimental-music evening at Fylkingen; the lineup and artistic format deserve a closer look before committing.

new_discoveries.title: Sound of Stockholm — Thursday
new_discoveries.description: The opening festival night ranges across microtonality, electronics and performance; a strong opportunity to sample unconventional sound-making in a dedicated experimental space.

new_discoveries.title: Sound of Stockholm — Friday
new_discoveries.description: Experimental improvisation and electronic sound, including harpist Rhodri Davies among a broad festival lineup. Good if you prefer something challenging and unpredictable.

new_discoveries.title: Strage Sessions: The Aesthetics of Punk
new_discoveries.description: Fredrik Strage leads a discussion of punk's visual language with Lotta Antonsson and guests, followed by a DJ set and exhibition closing celebration.
new_discoveries.price: Included in regular admission; members free

new_discoveries.title: Sound of Stockholm — Saturday
new_discoveries.description: An evening mixing experimental music, vocal performance and dance. Anna Fitoussi and Adele Kosman's short voice-and-movement works are a particularly interesting cross-disciplinary element.

new_discoveries.title: Anden i Glaset: 2026
new_discoveries.description: A staged Victorian séance mixing mentalism, illusion, psychology and voluntary audience participation. More playful theatrical mystery than a traditional magic show.
new_discoveries.booking: Tickets listed via Ticketmaster; seats unverified

worth_reconsidering.title: Roof of Reflection — 360° fulldome film
worth_reconsidering.description: A meditative film at Wisdome weaving contemporary sculpture, aurora imagery and light research into a full-dome experience. The unusual presentation format is the draw.
worth_reconsidering.price: Price unverified; museum/film ticket conditions apply

worth_reconsidering.title: Embraced — immersive sculpture and sound
worth_reconsidering.description: An exhibition designed to make the viewer part of the work through sculpture, textile, sound and spatial installations. Lower-intensity than a performance, but physically engaging.
worth_reconsidering.booking: Opening hours only; check exhibition access

worth_reconsidering.title: ANDETAG Listening Evening — Tubular Bells
worth_reconsidering.description: An entire Mike Oldfield album played communally inside ANDETAG's slow-light installation. This is the special programmed session, not generic museum admission.
worth_reconsidering.price: Price unverified; regular admission reference 240 SEK

worth_reconsidering.title: ANDETAG Art Yoga
worth_reconsidering.description: Slow yoga inside the immersive installation: a more participatory way to experience the space, distinct from standard admission.

worth_reconsidering.title: ANDETAG Listening Evening — Górecki Symphony No. 3
worth_reconsidering.description: A collective deep-listening session for Górecki's Symphony of Sorrowful Songs within the installation's shifting light. Strong if you enjoy emotionally immersive music.
worth_reconsidering.price: Price unverified; regular admission reference 240 SEK

worth_reconsidering.title: Sound of Stockholm — festival pass
worth_reconsidering.dates: 19–21 Nov within the guide window; festival continues 22 Nov
worth_reconsidering.description: For a deeper exploration of improvisation, electronics, loudspeaker music and performance, the multi-day pass is better value than separate nights if you plan to attend several.
